documents.title: Operations handbook
documents.truth_text:
# Deployment rollout
Production deployments use a canary rollout before full release. The rollback window stays open until health checks are green and the operator closes the release gate.

# Database backup retention
Database snapshots are retained for thirty days. Restore drills verify that retained snapshots can be recovered before older backups expire.

documents.title: Security handbook
documents.truth_text:
# Access review
Quarterly access reviews remove stale accounts and confirm that privileged roles still have a named owner.

# Backup encryption
Database backups are encrypted at rest. Backup encryption keys rotate every ninety days and are held separately from restore credentials.

documents.title: Release notes
documents.truth_text:
# Database changes
The October release changes the connection pool defaults and adds a migration warning.

# Access changes
The same release updates the sign-in screen and removes an obsolete role label.

documents.title: Incident guide
documents.truth_text:
# Severity one escalation
A severity one incident pages the incident commander immediately when customer data is unavailable or integrity is at risk.

documents.title: Vendor onboarding guide
documents.truth_text:
# Insurance evidence
A new vendor must provide current insurance evidence before procurement marks onboarding complete.
